sources.title: Plasma Surrogate Modelling using Fourier Neural Operators
sources.snippet: We demonstrate accurate predictions of plasma evolution both in simulation and experimental domains using deep learning-based surrogate modelling tools, viz., Fourier Neural Operators (FNO).

sources.snippet: The top middle panel shows the posterior mean of the initial vorticity given the noisy observations estimated with MCMC using the traditional solver. while the top right panel shows the same thing but using FNO as a surrogate model.

sources.title: Plasma surrogate modelling using Fourier neural operators
sources.snippet: The FNO offers a viable alternative for surrogate modelling as it is quick to train and infer, and requires fewer data points, while being able to do zero-shot super-resolution and getting high-fidelity solutions.

sources.title: Plasma-FNO · GitHub
sources.snippet: A modified version of the FNO capable of handling multiple variables that govern a family of PDEs, allowing for learning and encoding the mutual dependence of variables. Demonstration of the FNO's utility in surrogate modelling the evolution of plasma across a range of reduced magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) cases with increasing complexity.
